body:
## Summary
- Moves `NotFound`, `ConversationNotFound`, `UserNotFound`, `RecordNotFound`, `Rejected`, `Chunk`, `Attachment` and `RecordContext` into `medas-api/schema/schema.py`, re-exported from `schema/__init__.py`.
- `schema` imports nothing from the project, so every layer can import it without cycles; `controller/documents.py` no longer imports `NotFound` from `controller/conversation.py`.
- ORM classes, `Base`, the enums, settings classes and `LoadedPdf` stay where they are (Alembic reads `Base.metadata`; settings caches are cleared in `conftest.py`).
- Imports updated across `controller/`, `langchain_agent/`, `rag_pipeline/`, `main.py`, the eval scripts and tests; `CLAUDE.md` and the README note the new home. Also removes stray blank lines in `main.py` that failed `ruff format`.

## Test plan
- [x] `ruff check`, `ruff format --check`, `pytest -q` (172 passed)
- [x] Ran the API and UI locally: signed-in chat question answered by the agent (`POST /ask` 201), no errors in the logs
- [ ] Not exercised live: the 404 path and PDF upload (covered by unit tests)
